name: automation-platform
description: Centralized launcher for the Automation Platform (frontend + all backend services).

scripts.backend:sprintguard: cross-env API_HOST=127.0.0.1 API_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn backend.sprintguard.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/sprintguard
scripts.backend:load-testing: cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/load-testing/src python -m uvicorn lt.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload --reload-dir backend/load-testing/src
scripts.backend:api-testing: cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/api-testing APIT_PORT=8002 python -m uvicorn apitest.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --reload --reload-dir backend/api-testing/apitest
scripts.backend:ui-automation: cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/ui-automation BASE_URL=http://localhost:8003 DASHBOARD_URL=http://localhost:5174 python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8003 --reload --reload-dir backend/ui-automation/app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend/src/components/load-testing ci && npm --prefix frontend/src/components/api-testing ci && npm --prefix frontend/src/components/ui-automation ci && npm --prefix backend/ui-automation-server ci && npm --prefix backend/ui-automation-server exec playwright install chromium && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/api-testing/requirements.txt -r backend/ui-automation/requirements.txt -e "backend/load-testing[dev]" && python -m playwright install chromium
